newsitem.title: USA: Coca-Cola sees higher Q1 volume/gallon sales. [CORRECTED 16:15 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Coca-Cola sees higher Q1 volume/gallon sales. [CORRECTED 16:15 GMT]

text.p: Coca-Cola Co said Thursday it expects its worldwide unit case volume to increase by 7.0 to 8.0 percent in the first quarter.
It said worldwide gallon sales are expected to increase by 5.0 to 6.0 percent.
The projection covers unit case volume and gallon sales in North America, Latin America, Europe, Africa, the Middle East and Far East, Coca-Cola said.
One unit case is equal to 24 eight-ounce servings, according to a Coca-Cola spokeswoman.

The company said that as previously reported, it will record an after-tax gain of about $0.08 a share due to the sale of its 49 percent stake in the operations of Coca-Cola and Schweppes Beverages Ltd to Coca-Cola Enterprises.
It said the gain will be recorded in the first quarter and will contribute to both first quarter and full-year results.
